name: test_threejs
description: Collection of threejs examples, as well as demos, assets, modules and other resources that have to do with testing out the javaScript library.

paragraphs: This is a collection of work using the 3D computer graphics javaScript library called threejs. Many of these are very basic demos of features of the library itself, others progress beyond that into collections of code that may start to look like finished projects. However nothing here is really a kind of stand alone full project, as such this is a kind of threejs sketchpad of sorts.

I write about the state of the source code examples worked out here in blog posts that I publish on my github pages site. With that said there is a folder for each blog post that I have written thus far in the views folder.

There are other folders of interest, one of which is the demos folder which is broken down on a reversion by revision basis. So every now and then when new revisions come out I start a new folder for a late revision and test out if things still work okay for me, and if not what kind of changes need to happen with my code style to stay current. This can also go the other way when it comes to the various concerns with keeping code working on older devices, as well as interest with the history of this library. The demos folder is also where I test out new ideas for projects, as well as features…
